frontier.hypothesis: On the pa4-free chassis, target's block-0 emission order is reachable if tbl's definition can be EARLY (declaration-initialiser position, live 47) while tbl's priority still clears out2 -- which needs either a fifth tbl reference that emits no loop notes, or out2 pushed below 1702.
frontier.mechanism: tbl at 4 refs / live 47 = 1702; out2 at 4 refs / live 42..43 = 1904/1860. The gap is one floor_log2 step. E-s18-3 says only the loop-note dial produces an ODD reference delta, and every wrap measured this session costs 4..6 emission-order diffs; an F1 chain-extender gives +2 (tbl 6/47 = 2553), which overshoots i (2474) and steals $s4. The escape would be an F1 +2 combined with i's live length shortened below 93 (8/93 = 2580 > 2553), i.e. `i = 1;` demoted from a declaration initialiser to a later block-0 statement.
frontier.next_probe: Measure the pair together on the Q1/N3 chassis: keep tbl as a declaration initialiser but split its definition into a combine-foldable chain (watch the insn count FIRST -- a surviving addiu is fatal), and simultaneously demote `i = 1;` to a plain statement swept across block-0 positions, reading tbl/i/out2 priorities out of ALLOCDBG before looking at the score. Note the tbl chain-extender's only honest spelling may be out-of-bounds pointer arithmetic, in which case the measurement is a KILL, not a candidate.

frontier.hypothesis: The 4-position block-0 order cost of a late tbl definition is a sched1 ranking artifact that a dependency, not a position, could fix: if tbl's defining insn acquired an in-block successor, sched1 would schedule it early despite its late LUID.
frontier.mechanism: sched.c's rank_for_schedule ranks by INSN_PRIORITY (the dependency critical path) and falls back to INSN_LUID. tbl's lui/addiu pair has no consumer inside block 0 -- its only use is `lw $v0,0($s5)` in loop1 -- so its priority is minimal and it sinks, dragging the dependent `sw $s5,0x34($sp)` prologue save with it. Target's copy is early because its LUID is early.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate whether any block-0 value target already computes could legitimately be sourced from tbl (e.g. an address or a compare operand), giving the lui/addiu an in-block consumer without adding an insn; if none exists, this closes the late-tbl horn by derivation and leaves only the early-tbl horn from frontier item 1.
